title: Coordinates of the zero record
statement: Let $e$ be a record whose eleven natural-number fields, in order, are the circuit-input count, hard-wired-bit count, step budget, current instruction, preceding cell, first instruction of the current step, two loop counters, hard-wired and free input positions, and scratch space. The coordinate function of the zero record assigns $0$ to every slot from $0$ through $10$.
